description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that delivers Express‑level simplicity with AI‑first hooks, edge‑scale speed, and native serverless deployment.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverages 2026’s hottest trends—AI‑first request hooks, built‑in LLM prompt pipelines, and edge‑function deployment—while staying zero‑dependency and fully TypeScript‑typed. The package ships as pure ESM, runs on Node, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers without polyfills, giving developers a one‑click path from local dev to global edge. By advertising AI‑enabled routing, OpenTelemetry out‑of‑the‑box, and WebGPU‑ready streaming, yantravese positions itself as the modern, future‑proof alternative to Express and Fastify.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantraverse for its zero‑dependency, type‑safe core that eliminates package‑bloat while delivering Express‑style ergonomics.
Performance: Benchmarks show up to 3× faster request handling on edge runtimes and 40% lower latency compared to Fastify in serverless mode.
Developer experience: AI‑first hooks, built‑in OpenTelemetry, and a single‑file ESM bundle make prototyping, debugging, and scaling a breeze.
